theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_fa_polar_gram_jacobian
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e x : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → 0 < inner ℝ x a → Module.finrank ℝ T = 2 → T.starProjection x = x → Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ T) => (fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => (‖y‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a))) x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T i)).1 * (fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => (‖y‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a))) x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T j)).1 + (fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => (‖y‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a))) x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T i)).2 * (fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => (‖y‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a))) x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ T j)).2)) = ‖T.starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2
